bugs.title: Bug triage
bugs.targets: Severity × customers affected · targets S1 {s1} · S2 {s2} business days · S3 {s3} days

bugs.dueNote: The due time follows from the severity and the targets in Settings, counted from now.
bugs.incidentsNote: The open incidents of the problem ticket count too; they are linked on the problem, in Customers › Tickets.
bugs.mergeBody: Pick the bug this one duplicates. Its tickets and its problem move there, its cards on the board follow, and this one closes as a duplicate.
bugs.noOthers: There is no other bug of this product to merge into.
bugs.fixPlain: The bug closes. No customer is told: it has no problem ticket with open incidents.
bugs.fixTells: The problem {ref} is resolved and the customers on its {n, plural, one {# open ticket} other {# open tickets}} get this message.
bugs.fixProblem: The problem {ref} is resolved too. It has no open incidents, so no customer is told.

bugs.fixMessage: Message to the customers on the open linked tickets
bugs.fixedToastProblem: Fixed · problem resolved · {n, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} told

useNote.spec_draft: Use writes the five sections into this item's spec as a new revision (sign-offs lapse). Edit it there.

useNote.release_note_draft: Use adds each line as a draft release note. Nothing is published until a person publishes it.

claude.title: Claude connection
claude.what: Claude reads only Sentral's own records for these drafts: the roadmap item, its spec, its work items and counts of what is linked. Never a ticket's text, a customer's name or survey data.
claude.keyNote: The key goes straight to the vault with a one-time number after your authenticator code; it is never shown again.
